prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Create an exceptionally beautiful image for a contemporary premium pet photography and memories website. Art direction: playful fashion editorial, exquisite detail, clean sculptural composition, luminous soft daylight, rich but restrained pastel colours, tactile materials, delightful personality. Prioritise aesthetic impact over literal app-output realism. The pet must look alive, sweet and naturally expressive, with believable anatomy and finely resolved fur. No human body, no human hands, no extra limbs, no stock-photo props clutter, no sepia filter, no brown vintage room, no app interface, no watermark, no logos. No lettering unless explicitly specified. Full bleed, no outer border. Landscape quirky fashion editorial of a cream Devon Rex cat perched on a giant cherry-red spherical cushion against pale lavender. Huge ears, amber eyes, small head tilt, a sculptural blue silk collar. Clever high-end colour blocking, impeccable detail, irresistibly expressive, uncrowded studio composition. Intended final composition 1600:1200; keep face, ears and important artwork comfortably within the central safe area for a small crop.
